airbnb-for-freelancers.reason: Starting freelance work must describe a recognizable brief/scope/onboarding action. Access codes entered in an inbox and a scope stored in a lockbox do not explain a product mechanic.
rejected_phrases: scope of work will be in the lockbox

airbnb-for-freelancers.reason: Exclusive availability blocks other clients from booking time; it does not physically relocate those clients to a building elsewhere.
A perk must identify a recognizable freelance service or client behavior, rather than combine unrelated hospitality and work words.
rejected_phrases: Hot water in the feedback channel
Two towels and a statement of work

airbnb-for-freelancers.reason: Booking confirmation must explain the work handoff. Source files under a doormat, paragraphs on a pillow and metaphors stored in a fridge have no established meaning in this product.
rejected_phrases: welcome paragraph is on the pillow

facebook-for-wedding-djs.reason: The original QA review found that paid social-network verification inexplicably grants physical venue access. Replace this with an intelligible in-network verification benefit in concept and landing copy.
rejected_phrases: Verified access to the loading entrance
